title: A Clock for the Compass
author: Theo Halloran
blurb: Rafael Montrose, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
